services.name: Jetski Rental
services.desc: NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY! - We have everything you need including life jackets, safety training, and instructions. Customer Service is very important to us! NO CHARGE for Gas, Passengers, or Safety equipment Our Safety Record- Safety is very important to us, so we will make sure to give you the proper instructions and safety course to make you feel comfortable while riding our jet skis. Maryland State law requires that all drivers of Personal Watercraft must be at least 18 years of age with a driver’s license. (State ID & learners permits cannot be accepted.) Passengers can be 3 years of age and older. Anyone under 18 will need to have a parent or legal guardian sign on the legal documents.
